answer: To resist sybils, agents must forge unique hardware tokens from scarce copper that can only be mined in a specific glacier region. Each token requires a physical minting process verified by geolocation proofs from the glacier site, costing roughly 50 tokens in materials and logistics. An attacker creating 100 fakes must source 100 separate copper batches and travel to the glacier repeatedly, making the cost linear and prohibitive while honest agents forge once.
